en.headline: David Silva comes out of retirement to join Supreme Sha Tin
en.dek: The former Spain and Manchester City midfielder, 40, is expected in Hong Kong soon for a fitness check before training with the Premier League club.
body: Former Spain midfielder David Silva has come out of retirement at 40 to join Hong Kong Premier League club Supreme Sha Tin, RTHK reported on Thursday morning.

Silva spent a decade at Manchester City and won the 2010 World Cup and two European Championships with Spain. He retired in 2023 after tearing an anterior cruciate ligament in pre-season training at Real Sociedad.

In an Instagram video he said he was excited to go to Hong Kong and to enjoy the local culture, the food in Sha Tin, and football in the city. The club said he would arrive soon to settle in, join squad training and build match fitness before a debut.
Supreme Sha Tin, promoted this season, are eighth after four matches. Their next fixture is against Hong Kong Football Club on 18 October.

zh.headline: 施華四十歲復出 加盟港超球會沙田
zh.dek: 前西班牙及曼城中場施華將抵港接受體能評估，再與球隊訓練，沙田下一仗於十月十八日對香港足球會。
body: 前西班牙國家隊中場施華以四十歲之齡復出，加盟香港超級聯賽球會沙田。香港電台周四早引述報道指出，他將於短期內抵港。
施華曾效力曼城十年，並隨西班牙奪得二零一零年世界盃及兩屆歐洲國家盃。他於二零二三年在皇家蘇薩達季前操練時十字韌帶撕裂，其後退役。
施華在一段影片中說，很期待到香港，享受本地文化、沙田美食，以及香港的足球。球會表示，他抵港後會先安頓，再加入操練並回復比賽狀態，其後才作處子登場。
今季升班的沙田打完四場後排第八。下一仗於十月十八日對香港足球會。
